command:
set -uo pipefail; G="$1"; M="$2"; P="$3"; O="$4"; mkdir -p "$O"
arm() { name="$1"; shift; total="$1"; shift; tails="$1"; shift
  echo "== arm $name total=$total tails=$tails env: $*"
  env MEMRA_PRIME_ROW_RECEIPT=1 "$@" "$G" "$M" "$P" "$total" $tails > "$O/arm-$name.log" 2>&1
  echo "exit=$?" >> "$O/arm-$name.log"; grep -v "^\[prime-row\]" "$O/arm-$name.log"; }
arm S0-baseline 9296 "16 48"
arm S1-nobatched 9296 "16 48" MEMRA_NO_BATCHED=1
arm S2-nobatched-chunk32 9296 "16 48" MEMRA_NO_BATCHED=1 MEMRA_PRIME_CHUNK=32
arm S3-nobatched-t17 9297 "17" MEMRA_NO_BATCHED=1
